WDIV and the Detroit News commissioned a survey of likely voters in Michigan’s November 2026 general election. The poll was conducted by The Glengariff Group, Inc.

It was a 600-sample, live-operator telephone survey that was conducted on Aug. 31 through Sept. 3, 2026.

The margin of error is +/-4.0%, and there is a 95% level of confidence.

Of the respondents, 15.0% of respondents were called via landline telephone, and 85.0% were called on a cellphone. The president’s continued struggles in the polls come ahead of a vital midterm season as his party seeks to hold slim majorities in both the House of Representatives and the Senate.

The Focaldata/Financial Times poll was conducted from Aug. 28 to Sept. 2 with 2,178 U.S. adults participating.

President Donald Trump speaks during a "Steel Across America" event on the Ellipse near the White House on Sept. 8, 2026 in Washington, DC. [...] The poll, released on Sunday, Sept. 6, found that only 32% of Americans approved of Trump’s job performance, a three-point drop from last month’s edition and the lowest the president has seen in Focaldata/Financial Times tracking since it began in May.

results.content: Donald Trump’s problems are having a major, perhaps decisive, impact on the 2026 race for control of the Senate. Driven by high prices and an unfinished war with Iran, his national job approval stands at just 39.6% compared to a disapproval rating of 57.0%—a net negative of 17.4%—and it is even worse in several states that could make the difference between a Republican and Democratic Senate majority after the midterms.
